item.description: During my rounds of system design interviews, I quickly realized that the technology we use to communicate can influence the flow, clarity, and ultimately the success of the interview. item.description: "I'm here to talk to you about the Avenger Initiative." item.description: In this article, we'll explore how to build a local legal risk analysis system that doesn't "hallucinate" text, but instead relies on hard links to the legal framework and case law.
